name: @hello-ai-company/editor-publish
description: Safe HTML, Markdown, presentation, DOCX, and PDF-print exports for OpenEditor documents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hello-ai-company/editor-core && npm run build -w @hello-ai-company/editor-canvas && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hello-ai-company/editor-core && npm run build -w @hello-ai-company/editor-canvas && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
